jobs.description: At GoMeddo, I build and maintain features across our product suite, working closely with a cross-functional team to define requirements and design scalable solutions. My work spans both the Salesforce platform and Amazon Web Services, where I develop enhancements using React, Python, Lightning Web Components, and Apex.

Delivered consulting, analysis, and implementation services to help clients optimize their use of Salesforce and its integrations. Designed and built scalable, test-driven solutions using HTML/CSS, JavaScript, Apex, and SOQL. Also provided mentorship to stakeholders and junior developers, guiding effective participation throughout the software development lifecycle.

Led the transition to a version control–driven development model, refactored Apex unit tests to use mocking frameworks, and introduced test-driven development practices for Lightning Web Components using Jest. Delivered full-stack development across Experience, Sales, and Service Clouds, while supporting internal stakeholders with Salesforce CPQ enhancements. Simulated key processes in New Relic to improve Salesforce Community Cloud metrics, managed CI/CD workflows, and mentored junior developers throughout the development lifecycle.

Delivered Salesforce CPQ consulting and implementation services for B2B clients, collaborating closely with the VP of Customer Solutions to develop tailored Salesforce strategies. Designed and developed features using Lightning Components, JavaScript, and Apex to extend and enhance Salesforce CPQ functionality.

Designed, developed, and maintained Salesforce web applications for clients, troubleshooting issues in both Salesforce and Boomi middleware environments. Collaborated with cross-functional technical teams to plan and implement solutions, conducted client demos, and provided ad-hoc technical guidance as needed.

Delivered implementation services for a recurring billing web application, developing both front-end and back-end features using PHP, JavaScript, Java, Python, HTML, CSS, and MySQL. Managed monthly feature update newsletters and provided ongoing customer support to clients.
